name: Bicycle
stable: Pelvis and spine, held up by the hands
summary: From the Scissors position, the far leg bends and sweeps under as the other reaches over: a slow pedal, then reversed.
steps: Prop the pelvis on the hands as for Scissors.
Reach one straight leg away, bend that knee and draw the heel towards the seat.
Bring the bent knee through to the chest as the other leg reaches away.
Pedal five times, then reverse the direction.

layers.title: Reverse
layers.text: Lead with the knee to the chest, then reach away.

layers.title: Bigger circle
layers.text: The far foot aims for the mat.

cautions.note: Weight is on the shoulders and upper back.
Inverted and loaded through the abdominals.
Inverted and loaded through the abdominals.
Loaded flexion on the upper spine.

cues:
Hips stay level in the hands.
Reach long before you bend.
No weight on the neck.
